label: Scene Template: Problem Chaos Collage
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: THE PROBLEM BEAT. A headline stands still while the mess it names swarms around it -- notifications, half-read stats, voice memos, unanswered messages arriving off-kilter and drifting at two depths. THE grammar for 'this is what your week actually looks like', spent ONCE and EARLY, before the product appears; a second one reads as a tic. The swarm is capped in opacity and sits behind a radial scrim so the headline never competes with it. Set `resolve` to clear the swarm on the back half -- chaos that is never answered is just anxiety, so use the resolve whenever the scene is the setup for the product rather than a standalone gut-punch. Dark by default.

headline.label: The problem, stated plainly; | breaks lines

cards.label: 6-14 pieces of the mess: [{kind:'notification'|'stat'|'waveform'|'message', title, body?, value?}]. Real fragments from the audience's actual week, never lorem.

subhead.label: One quiet line under the headline

resolve.label: Truthy clears the swarm on the back half; a STRING also lands as the answer line (e.g. 'One thread.')

logo_url.label: Wordmark URL; defaults to the brand-kit wordmark
